data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Attractions & Tickets, city, keyword, search, sort, open top result) and names city, keyword and sort as parameters, but it leaves out the final action (view nearby or add to favorites) as a parameter and limits sort to two options, so an automation would lack the last step's variation.
